page.overview:
Who is Big figure?

Big figure refers to the subtype of Minifigure that is usually taller and more bulky than standard minifigures. Often appearing in licensed themes, they consist of the same articulation as standard minifigures, but have one less piece (9).

In design, Big Figures (often shortened as "Big fig") are very similar to the standard Minifigure design, yet they look completely different, as they are meant to depict more muscular and big characters. The most famous examples include The Hulk, Thanos, Killer Croc, the Rock Monster, and Jabba the Hutt (the latter 2 are an example on how different big figures' design can be).
